title: Autonomous Maintenance Platform — System Context (C1) · MVP as built, 2026-07

nodes.name: Autonomous Maintenance Platform
nodes.desc: Runs an autonomous developer, machine reviewers and an E2E tester as ephemeral bursts; two human gates bracket the loop

nodes.name: Human Owner
nodes.desc: Triages issues (ready), reviews PRs, merges — the only identity that can merge

nodes.name: End Users
nodes.desc: Real users; their content is untrusted data, never instructions

nodes.name: Product
nodes.desc: The maintained product (first instance: a Discord bot); deploys via its own CI on human merge

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.desc: Issues = queue · PRs = delivery + review · branch protection = human gate · CI

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.desc: Agent engine for dev, reviewer and tester bursts (owner-subscription OAuth)

nodes.name: GitHub Copilot
nodes.desc: Optional extra machine reviewer, requested per PR on the owner's PAT

nodes.name: Product Sandbox
nodes.desc: Disposable test Discord app + empty guild where the tester drives the product E2E

nodes.name: Monitor
nodes.desc: Not built (phase 1+): will watch prod telemetry and file auto issues
